title: Pig eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='pigBody' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb3c9'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f77fa3'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='pigSnout' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd6e2'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff9cba'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='30' y='74' width='9' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e56b91'/>
  <rect x='44' y='76' width='9' height='12' rx='3' fill='#e56b91'/>
  <rect x='60' y='74' width='9' height='14' rx='3' fill='#e56b91'/>
  <rect x='72' y='76' width='9' height='12' rx='3' fill='#e56b91'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='58' rx='34' ry='24' fill='url(#pigBody)'/>

  <!-- tail curl -->
  <path d='M88 50 q10 -2 8 6 q-2 6 -8 2' fill='none' stroke='#f77fa3' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='44' r='20' fill='url(#pigBody)'/>

  <!-- ears -->
  <path d='M14 28 q-2 -14 10 -11 q4 1 -2 12 z' fill='#ff9cba'/>
  <path d='M38 26 q6 -13 14 -6 q3 3 -8 11 z' fill='#ff9cba'/>

  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='16' cy='50' rx='12' ry='9' fill='url(#pigSnout)'/>
  <ellipse cx='12' cy='50' rx='2.4' ry='3.2' fill='#c9507a'/>
  <ellipse cx='20' cy='50' rx='2.4' ry='3.2' fill='#c9507a'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='38' r='3.2' fill='#5a1733'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='38' r='3.2' fill='#5a1733'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='37' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='39' cy='37' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- cheek -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='48' r='4' fill='#ff8fb0' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- snack: cookie on a little hand -->
  <circle cx='8' cy='66' r='9' fill='#e8b563'/>
  <circle cx='8' cy='66' r='9' fill='none' stroke='#c98f3c' stroke-width='2'/>
  <circle cx='5' cy='63' r='1.6' fill='#7a4a1e'/>
  <circle cx='11' cy='64' r='1.6' fill='#7a4a1e'/>
  <circle cx='8' cy='69' r='1.6' fill='#7a4a1e'/>
  <circle cx='13' cy='70' r='1.4' fill='#7a4a1e'/>

  <!-- front hoof holding cookie -->
  <ellipse cx='18' cy='63' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#e56b91'/>
  <path d='M14 61 q4 2 8 0' fill='none' stroke='#c9507a' stroke-width='1.6' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- crumbs -->
  <circle cx='2' cy='74' r='1.3' fill='#e8b563'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='75' r='1.1' fill='#e8b563'/>
</svg>
